record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: BRAIXEN, DELPHOX and FENNEKIN (the queued units; the only units declaring MYSTICAL_FIRE in the catalog).
record.summary: Single-target special damage (20 / 40 / 80 / 160 raw by caster stars), then the same target loses ability power: a requested -15 / -20 / -25 / -50 AP, scaled by the CASTER's AP and by the crit factor if the cast crit. The AP loss is not capped by the damage hit and is applied even if that hit was blocked or killed the target.

effects.scaling: requested amount: x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost default true); x2 if DOUBLE_DAMAGE (consumed); crit multiplier only if the cast crit (canCritByDefault false: needs ABILITY_CRIT)
effects.resolution: applied amount: then the target's SPE_DEF division (damage / (1 + 0.05 x SPE_DEF)) and later handleDamage modifiers; blocked entirely by protect / skydiving / magicBounce (magicBounce can reflect it); results (death, takenDamage incl. shield damage) are ignored by this ability

effects.target: the damaged target (same entity as the hit)

declaredRaw.note: requested AP loss magnitudes as written in the source table; the code passes them negated, i.e. -15 / -20 / -25 / -50 (fallback -50)

effects.scaling: requested amount: round(value x (1 + 1 x casterAP/100) x critPower-if-crit), apBoost 1 is passed: a caster with more AP removes more AP, and a crit multiplies it
effects.resolution: applied amount: if the target holds NULLIFY_BANDANNA the AP loss is skipped and instead its ATK changes by round(0.2 x requested value) (negative, e.g. -3 / -4 / -5 / -10 before addAttack's own helpers) through addAttack(.., caster, 0, false); otherwise Big Eater Belt does not apply (the value is negative and the caster is an enemy), Twist Band on the target flips the negative value to positive, so the target GAINS that much AP (also in the nullify branch through addAttack); then target.ap = max(-100, ap + value); not permanent (the board unit is unchanged); the change happens whether or not the damage hit was blocked

starBehavior.note: both tables are indexed by the casting entity's stars (pokemon.stars - 1); the 4-star entries (160 damage, -50 AP) and the fallbacks are not reached by these units' bare star counts (2, 3, 1). maxPP is 80 and range 2 for all three.

record.positionalConditions: None beyond the target being within the caster's range (2).
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No state is kept by the ability; each cast removes AP again and the target's AP can keep falling to the floor of -100. No modes.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested damage 20 / 40 / 80 (FENNEKIN / BRAIXEN / DELPHOX); applied = x(1 + AP/100) [x2 DOUBLE_DAMAGE] [x crit], then the SPE_DEF division and later modifiers (takenDamage unused). Requested AP change -15 / -20 / -25; applied = round(value x (1 + casterAP/100) x crit factor), then Twist Band may flip its sign on the target, Nullify Bandanna converts it into a 20% ATK change, and the target's AP is floored at -100.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after handleDamage's later modifiers (shields, items, damage-reduction effects, resurrection) - only the SPECIAL speDef division and the minimum of 1 were read
